title: T16 — Project Brief
body:
# Project brief

## Outcome

The conveyor ingests SOPs, RDF/OWL ontologies and BPMN/Visio/draw.io documents into governed procedure drafts
that a person publishes, and a bound job executes the PDDL steps.

## Boundary

Not in scope: the procedure catalogue UI (T18) and the process engine (S13).

## Reuse sources

The action spine's governed assets and documents, the capability/job families, the process executor (S13), and
the D53 decision (knowledge pack, no RDF store at runtime).

## Inception units

The ingestion actions (`procedures.ingest_*`), the review/publish gates, and the re-ingest versioning path.

## Dependencies

T2 (plan spine), T13 (governed assets), P0 (programme definition); S13 for execution.

## Acceptance

SPEC_V2 §12 T16, proven by 25/25 named tests at lane head `46fc49e2`; manifest `acceptance/programme/T16.toml`.

## Capabilities

A team can turn its written procedures into executable, versioned procedures without hand-authoring the
action space.

## Plan

Delivered in tranche 4; the PI plan for tranche 4 carries the objectives and capacity.

## Risks

The systemic-improvement loop (T5) and the operations path (T7) are the coupled slices; the human gate and the
knowledge-pack decision are the mitigations.
